headline:

panes.title: WHAT CHANGES
lines: daily emission drops from 1.68 million to *1.59 million KAS*. no vote, no announcement.

post.x: the next kaspa reward cut lands in about 12 days, an estimate. bitcoin waits about 510 days for its next one, and kaspa cuts 16 more times before that date. daily emission drops from 1.68 million to 1.59 million KAS, the block reward from 1.9445 to 1.8354.
post.reply: the countdown runs on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the kaspa date and the bitcoin date are both estimates, the kaspa step is set by daa score.
